message: The other day, I found myself in a rare moment of feeling prepared. My grandson was visiting, and after a little chat about his school project, I suddenly remembered my go-bag tucked in the closet. I pulled it out, and we began to go through it together, packing snacks and water, and even double-checking our emergency plan. 🌟 It felt good to be the one who was ready for a change! Sometimes, it's the little things that make you feel like you've got it all together. Do you have a little emergency kit at home?
